fusions.name: Gavel Ruling
fusions.desc: A gavel blow that deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Press Run
fusions.desc: Brings a printing press down around you, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles that ignores armour, and leaves each one [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Case Dismissed
fusions.desc: Strikes the charges from the record: removes up to 2 conditions from you and every ally.

fusions.name: Pressman's Arms

riders.text: the press comes down faster every shift
and the long runs no longer tire you

fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1.
